metadata.title: ʿĀʾiša umm-al-muʾminīn fī turāṯ al-ġarb al-islāmī : buḥūṯ an-nadwa al-ʿilmīya allatī naẓẓamahā Markaz ʿUqba Ibn-Nāfiʾ li-d-Dirāsāt wa-'l-Abḥāṯ ḥaula aṣ-Ṣaḥāba wa-'t-Tābiʿīn, at-tābiʿ li-r-Rābiṭa al-Muḥammadīya li-l-ʿUlamāʾ, bi-madīnat Ṭunǧa, yaumai al-ǧumʿa wa-'s-sabt, 20-21 muḥarram 1433 h, 16-17 duǧanbir 2011 m
